EmailTemplate.subject: Welcome to Wadhwani Grants — your account is ready
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Welcome to Wadhwani Grants
Hello {!Receiving_User.FirstName},
Thank you for your interest in working with Wadhwani Grants. Your account for {!Receiving_User.CompanyName} is now active.
From here you can begin your Request for Information (RFI) - the first step in our grant process. You can save your progress and return as often as you need before submitting.
Start your application: {https://wadhwanifoundation--wfdev.sandbox.my.site.com/wcf/s/applicant-portal?language=en_US}
We look forward to learning more about the work {!Receiving_User.CompanyName} is doing to create and sustain jobs in your community.
Warm regards, The Wadhwani Grants Team
